task.description: Implemented REQ-225 exactly per the CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR-approved design (lib/letflow/design/req225-entity-definition-schema-validation.md): three new modules under lib/letflow/entities/ -- Letflow.Entities.Definition (entity_definition/field_def/index_def/fk_def/constraint_def @type shapes, §2), Letflow.Entities.Definition.Validator (all 11 structural validation rules 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8a,8b,8c,9 with the exact trigger conditions, rule atoms, and violation paths from §3, plus the :malformed shape precondition), and Letflow.Entities.Definition.Shape (content_hash/1 and logical_shape_of/1, both delegating to the existing Letflow.Repository.Canonicaliser per §4/§5 -- no second canonicaliser). Wrote test/letflow/entities/definition/validator_test.exs (37 tests: a conforming document validates :ok; each of the 11 rules independently fixture-triggered with only that rule's atom firing; malformed-shape precondition; multi-violation collection) and test/letflow/entities/definition/shape_test.exs (content_hash/1 proven to delegate to Canonicaliser.canonicalize_content/2 + content_hash/1 with no reimplementation; key-order/whitespace insensitivity verified directly against Canonicaliser; logical_shape_of/1's non-bumping cases -- field/list reordering, display_name/description changes -- and bumping cases -- field addition/removal/type change). Built nothing from REQ-225's explicit NOT-IN-SCOPE list: no entity_definitions migration, no persistence/CRUD context module, no ArtifactKind extension, no record-payload validation, no event registration, no routes/controllers.

No new canonicaliser module added (AC3) -- Shape.content_hash/1 and Shape.logical_shape_of/1 both call Letflow.Repository.Canonicaliser.canonicalize_content/2 and .content_hash/1 directly, verified by test asserting Shape.content_hash/1's output equals manually invoking the same two Canonicaliser calls.
